findings.title: Not met: Microsoft Ads — Page view sent once per load
findings.detail: Duplicates on one page load: 187000140×2 (from Shopify app: Microsoft Ads, Theme inline script) Why it matters: Double page views inflate traffic and deflate conversion rates; for ad pixels they distort optimisation.
findings.recommendation: Remove the second source (app vs GTM vs hard-coded / custom pixel).

findings.title: Tracking requests failing

findings.recommendation: Check each failing endpoint (blocked domain, retired pixel, wrong ID) and remove or fix the tag.

findings.title: Needs attention: Microsoft Ads — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Shopify app: Microsoft Ads x8; Theme inline script x8. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: On Shopify, keep the native app integration (server-side events, consent API, maintained by the platform) and remove the GTM / theme / custom-pixel copy unless it adds something the app can't.

findings.title: Ad pixels fire on load (no banner shown to this visitor)
findings.detail: Shopify Privacy Banner is present but showed no banner to this US visitor; Campaign Manager 360 / Floodlight, Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, Meta Pixel, Microsoft Ads (UET), Pinterest Tag, TikTok Pixel fired on load — consistent with a US opt-out model.
findings.recommendation: Confirm EU/UK visitors get an opt-in banner and US opt-out (Do Not Sell / GPC) suppresses these pixels.

analyst_checklist.item: Check the footer for a 'Your Privacy Choices / Do Not Sell or Share' link (none found on the homepage HTML)
Do GA4 revenue and Google Ads / Meta purchase counts reconcile with Shopify orders (a gap above ~10% usually means a tracking problem)?
Microsoft Ads are fed by more than one route (Microsoft Ads: Shopify app, Theme). Who manages each, and which one is meant to be the source of truth?
Is the Facebook & Instagram app's data sharing set to 'Maximum' (Conversions API on), and what Event Match Quality do Purchase events get?
Which conversion action is primary for purchases — the Google & YouTube app, a GTM tag or a GA4 import — and is enhanced conversions on?
Do you sell into the EU/UK or Quebec, and how is consent handled for those visitors?
Is Impact still an active partner? Its tracking requests fail.
Are browse- and cart-abandonment flows live in Klaviyo, and are Viewed Product / Added to Cart metrics recording?
